title: Fast AI inference
text: High-throughput AI systems use Rust and PyTorch for low-latency inference. Rust handles request routing, batching and memory-safe concurrency, while PyTorch runs the model itself. Dynamic batching groups incoming requests so the GPU stays busy without making individual users wait too long.

title: Uchakataji wa haraka wa AI
text: Mifumo ya akili bandia yenye kasi ya juu hutumia Rust na PyTorch kwa uchakataji wa haraka. Rust hushughulikia upangaji wa maombi na usalama wa kumbukumbu, wakati PyTorch huendesha modeli yenyewe. Kuweka maombi katika makundi husaidia GPU kufanya kazi bila kuwachelewesha watumiaji.

title: Быстрый инференс ИИ
text: Высокопроизводительные ИИ-системы используют Rust и PyTorch для быстрой инференции. Rust отвечает за маршрутизацию запросов и безопасную работу с памятью, а PyTorch выполняет саму модель. Динамическое объединение запросов в пакеты позволяет загружать GPU, не заставляя пользователей долго ждать.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
text: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) combines search with a large language model. Before answering, the system retrieves the most relevant passages from a knowledge base and gives them to the model as context. This grounds the answer in real documents, reduces hallucinations and lets the knowledge base be updated without retraining the model.

title: La génération augmentée par récupération
text: La génération augmentée par récupération (RAG) associe un moteur de recherche à un grand modèle de langage. Le système récupère d'abord les passages les plus pertinents, puis les fournit au modèle comme contexte. Les réponses sont ainsi ancrées dans des documents réels et la base de connaissances peut être mise à jour sans réentraîner le modèle.

title: Semantic caching
text: Semantic caching reduces LLM latency and cost by reusing answers to questions that mean the same thing. Each question is converted into an embedding vector; if a new question is close enough to a cached one, measured by cosine similarity above a threshold, the stored answer is returned instantly and the language model is never called.

title: Hifadhi ya maana (semantic caching)
text: Semantic caching hupunguza muda wa kusubiri na gharama za LLM kwa kutumia tena majibu ya maswali yenye maana moja. Kila swali hubadilishwa kuwa vekta ya maana; ikiwa swali jipya linakaribiana vya kutosha na swali lililohifadhiwa, jibu lililohifadhiwa hurudishwa mara moja bila kuita modeli ya lugha.

title: Семантический кэш
text: Семантический кэш снижает задержку и стоимость запросов к LLM, повторно используя ответы на вопросы с одинаковым смыслом. Каждый вопрос превращается в вектор; если новый вопрос достаточно близок к сохранённому по косинусному сходству, ответ возвращается мгновенно, без обращения к языковой модели.

title: Hybrid retrieval
text: Hybrid retrieval combines dense vector search with sparse keyword search such as BM25. Dense embeddings capture meaning across languages and paraphrases, while BM25 is precise for exact names, codes and rare terms. The two ranked lists are merged, for example with reciprocal rank fusion, which rewards passages that rank well in either list.

title: Utafutaji mseto
text: Utafutaji mseto huunganisha utafutaji wa vekta za maana na utafutaji wa maneno muhimu kama BM25. Vekta za maana huelewa maana hata katika lugha tofauti, wakati BM25 ni sahihi kwa majina, misimbo na maneno adimu. Orodha hizi mbili huunganishwa ili kupata vifungu bora zaidi.

title: Multilingual embeddings
text: Multilingual sentence embedding models such as paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 map sentences from more than fifty languages into one shared vector space. A question in Swahili and the same question in English end up close together, which is what allows cross-lingual search and cross-lingual cache hits.
